description: This file defines the WorkflowStateAddForm class for managing the addition of workflow states within Drupal's workflows module. It includes methods for form creation, validation, existence checking, and saving workflow state entities.

classes.name: WorkflowStateAddForm
classes.description: A form class for adding new workflow states in Drupal, extending EntityForm and handling form operations such as creation, validation, and saving of workflow state entities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the plugin form factory dependency.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static method to instantiate the form class with the container.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Builds the form array for adding a workflow state, including label, id, and optional type-specific settings.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a workflow state with the given ID already exists.

methods.name: copyFormValuesToEntity
methods.description: Copies form input values to the entity, adding a new state to the workflow.

methods.name: validateForm
methods.description: Validates the form, including any type-specific configuration validation.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the new workflow state and redirects to the workflow edit form.

methods.name: actions
methods.description: Defines form actions, primarily the submit button.
